description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Educations - Order to acquire the lands in Hatharaliyadda, Kundasale and Minipe D/S Division's  Kandy District for Water Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for water supply projects, including lot numbers, land names, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and references a legal act, the core content focuses on property acquisition and land descriptions, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
